0022600211.text: The Knicks (5-4, 3-2 at home) are on a three-game winning streak and sit 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back, as they play their 10th game of the season against the Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, 1-5 at home), who are on a six-game losing streak and 5th in the Central, 5.5 games back. Josh Hart is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for New York, while Gary Trent Jr. is out for Milwaukee with an illness. This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
